title: ShadowVale
description: We are a network where we make plugins, and servers help is granted at the discord. This server has multiple server, but the main one is crazyhearts where there are dungeons and new custom items.
body: We are an server, with many updates and helpful mods. We have a strict rule against admins admin abusing. And we have a kind comunity. We are strict against hackers, spammers, or any form of rasicme and swearing. We try to "not" make the server p2w. For this we have removed gamebling, op ranks, and we have even made a currency in which players can buy crate keys. While you might say crate keys? Aren't you #no gamebling, well we have made it so you can choose your reward.
